coding.display: Endodontic therapy, anterior tooth (excluding final restoration)
Permanent maxillary left central incisor tooth

note.text: Single-visit root canal therapy (CDT D3310, anterior tooth), tooth #9: the canal space was instrumented and obturated; patient tolerated the procedure well. The access was restored in the same visit (Procedure/procedure-d2330-composite). A definitive crown is still indicated, to be placed by a dentist the patient establishes as her dental home, because she has none (see the post-treatment CarePlan at Interaction 4). Tooth designation uses the ADA Universal Numbering System (#9); the source document's 'FDI 21' label is the separately-flagged FDI error and is deliberately NOT reproduced here, per ADA confirmation that FDI is not used for US dental data.
